statement_record.book: For an endofunctor T on a category C, a coalgebra is an object C together with a structure map C → TC; a morphism of coalgebras is a map of underlying objects making the evident square commute (target structure map after the map = T of the map after the source structure map); coalgebras and their morphisms form a category, and a TERMINAL coalgebra is a terminal object of that category.
